claims.text: Many reviewers report receiving the wrong quantity or color assortment, including missing colors, duplicates, and counts that don't match the 20-piece set.
Several reviewers praise fast shipping that arrived well ahead of the estimated delivery date.
Multiple reviewers describe the rings as very small or tiny, with some wishing the stones were bigger.
Several reviewers are happy with the quality and value, noting intact gems, good packaging, and a nice color variety for the price.
A few reviewers mention issues with the posts being short or thick, or gems glued on crooked.
